jobs.title: Sr Billing/AR Consultant
jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role

Samsara is looking for a Senior Escalations Program Manager to own our most complex customer escalations and turn those experiences into durable improvements. Approximately 70% of your time will be spent managing complex customer finance requests, you will coordinate cross-functional resources, lead executive-level communications, and drive rapid, high-quality resolution for high-severity customer issues. The remaining 30% of your time will focus on programs that eliminate root causes, streamline workflows, proactively resolve potential customer billing issues and scale customer-facing processes.

This role is ideal for a structured, customer-centered operator who can bring clarity to complex situations, build alignment across teams, and translate individual escalations into systemic improvements.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US except the San Francisco Bay Metro Area, NYC Metro Area, and Washington, D.C. Metro Area.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your work will help customers operate more safely, efficiently, and sustainably.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We create opportunities to learn, grow, and master your craft in a high-growth environment.
  • You’re energized by our opportunity: Digitizing large sectors of the global economy requires creative problem-solving, sound judgment, and a strong commitment to customer success.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, support each other, and hold ourselves accountable to high standards.

In this role, you will:

  • Own priority customer escalations end to end, including triage, action planning, cross-functional coordination, risk management, and real-time status updates to customers and executive stakeholders.
  • Serve as the single-threaded owner for complex escalations, creating structure and accountability across Sales, Finance, Support, Customer Success, Product, Engineering, and other partner teams.
  • Deliver clear post-mortems and executive summaries; track resolution progress, commitments, and follow-up actions through closure.
  • Analyze escalation themes and quantify business impact to identify and prioritize opportunities for process, product, and workflow improvement.
  • Lead cross-functional programs to improve the customer experience – standardize escalation workflows, service-level expectations, tooling, reporting, and dashboards.
  • Coach frontline teams on escalation prevention, de-escalation, customer communication, and effective use of escalation processes.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles—Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, and Win as a Team—as we scale globally and across new offices.

Success in this role will be measured by:

  • Reduced mean time to resolution (MTTR) for high-severity escalations.
  • Improved post-escalation CSAT and NPS.
  • Increased percentage of systemic issues permanently fixed within 90 days.
  • Consistent SLA adherence and audit-ready escalation documentation.
  • Clear stakeholder accountability and completion of commitments arising from escalations.

  • 4+ y

Technical Consultant 

We are looking for a technical consultant who thrives at the intersection of code and customer. As a member of our Technical Services team, you’ll help our most strategic customers deeply integrate Asana into their ecosystems through custom automations, integrations, and strategic guidance. jobs.title: Senior Channel Partner Manager, Global Advisory / GSI
jobs.description: ABOUT RAMP Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books. The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving. We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome. The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same. If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it. About the Role Ramp is building institutional partnerships with the GSI (Global System Integrators), Big-Four consulting firms, and global advisory firms that shape finance transformation, ERP modernization, and technology decisions for the CFOs and finance leaders we serve. These organizations are often in the room when enterprise clients are redesigning their finance stack, selecting technology, or moving from strategy into implementation. This portfolio spans the largest global professional services firms (e.g., Deloitte) and GSIs (e.g., Infosys). They are complex organizations with distinct service lines (e.g., ERP, Tech Modernization, Finance Transformation) each with its own leadership, incentives, and economics, so earning credibility inside one is as much about navigating the firm as it is about the relationship. This role will own Ramp's relationship with that network of firms, building firm-specific go-to-market motions that can include executive engagement, account mapping, co-sell, implementation alignment, thought leadership, and events. Ramp's relationships here are early and largely informal today, so this person will be responsible for the relationship, the partnership thesis, and the operating motion that makes a firm a meaningful Ramp partner over time. What You'll Do - Own Ramp's relationships with a portfolio of the largest global professional services, GSIs, and consulting firms, serving as the primary relationship owner - Map each firm and build credibility with the partners, practice leaders, alliance teams and client-service teams who matter most - Turn executive introductions into structured partnerships, developing the partnership thesis, executive sponsor plan, target practices and client wedge for each firm - Negotiate and close the first formal agreements between Ramp and these firms - Build market-facing proof points with Ramp's leadership, marketing and product teams, including executive events, thought leadership and shared client stories - Coordinate execution across Ramp, bringing the right Account Executives, Customer Success Managers, Product, AI Solutions and executive sponsors into each firm relationship - Establish and maintain the operating cadence: relationship maps, firm plans, account maps and next steps What You Need - 6+ years of experience in consulting, alliances, partnerships or an adjacent role. Time inside a top-tier professional services or global consulting firm (e.g., McKinsey, Bain, BCG, Deloitte) is strongly preferred. - Exceptional executive presence. You can hold a room with senior leaders, earn trust quickly, and be trusted to represent Ramp in meetings without support - Fluency in how large, matrixed professional services firms actually work, including how practices are incentivized and how a technology partner earns internal endorsement - Proven ability to run many workstreams and complex stakeholder management - A builder's instinct. You are energized by an empty page, comfortable without a playbook, and bring structure to ambiguity - Excellent written and verbal communication, and the judgment to calibrate between an executive conversation and a working session - Willingness to travel approximately 25% and to be based in a major metro. New York preferred BENEFITS AVAILABLE TO ALL FULL-TIME RAMP EMPLOYEES (GLOBAL) - Flexible PTO - Centralized home-office equipment ordering - Health and wellness stipend - Budget for intra-office travel - Weekly coffee stipend UNITED STATES - 100% medical, dental & vision insurance coverage for you, with partial coverage for dependents - One Medical annual membership - 401(k), including employer match on contributions made while employed by Ramp - Fertility HRA (up to $10,000 per year) - Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay - Pet insurance - In-office perks: lunch, snacks, drinks, and more - Relocation expense coverage to NYC or SF (if needed) CANADA - Group medical, dental, and vision coverage through Sun Life - Life, AD&D, and disability cover

jobs.title: R&D Insights and Operations - Growth
jobs.description:
About Gusto

At Gusto, we're on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff — payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR — so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. With teams in Denver, San Francisco, and New York, we support more than 500,000 small businesses nationwide and are building a workplace that reflects the people we serve.

All full-time employees receive competitive base pay, benefits, and equity (RSUs) — because everyone who helps build Gusto should share in its success. Offer amounts are determined by role, level, and location. Learn more about our Total Rewards philosophy.

AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process.

About the Role:

We're looking for a builder to help construct a world class Growth organization. This is an opinionated leader that is motivated by creating big picture vision and digging into where the biggest opportunities are, sizing them, and building the systems, rigor, and connective tissue that let Growth and GTM operate cohesively. This is a member of Gusto's Insights & Operations (I&O) team — our internal Strategy/BizOps function — embedded against Growth, partnering closely with our Head of Growth and our CRO-side GTM leadership.

This role is intentionally IC-first. You'll start by going deep on the highest-leverage problems in Growth, build a point of view grounded in data, and drive it to outcome. As trust and scope grow, this role is expected to expand — most likely into owning the operating bridge between Growth and our broader go-to-market organization, and potentially into building and leading a small team.

About the Team:

Gusto's Growth organization is on an ambitious trajectory: we're building toward a much more self-serve-led motion, and the opportunity ahead is significant. As Growth scales, we have a chance to be much more intentional about how it connects to Product and to our go-to-market teams (sales, demand gen, expansion sales, pricing, etc) — building a shared, prioritized roadmap and clear visibility into dependencies from the ground up, rather than retrofitting it later.

Here’s what you’ll do day-to-day:

  • Identify and size the highest-leverage opportunities for Growth: go from a fuzzy problem to a clear-eyed analysis of the opportunity, a recommendation on whether to pursue it, and a plan if the answer is yes.
  • Anchor on problems, not headcount: dig into what's actually slowing the Growth organization down, define how to build a best in class engine, size the opportunity, and decide what's worth solving before proposing who or what is needed — not the reverse.
  • Build the operating rhythm for Growth and drive execution against it: planning cycles, prioritization, and a shared, prioritized roadmap that makes trade-offs and dependencies visible across Growth R&D, Product R&D, and GTM.
  • Bring real analytical rigor to how Growth invests — attribution, LTV, and testing/experimentation discipline — so decisions about where to deploy resources are tied clearly to business impact.
  • Close the gap between Growth R&D and go-to-market: build the mechanisms (shared roadmap, dependency tracking, decision forums) that let both orgs operate as one team working toward the same number, rather than two orgs trading requests.
  • Design an operating system anchored in technology vs. humans: build the muscle and mechanisms the Growth org can through automation, and hand off ownership once a system is running
  • Act as a trusted advisor to Growth leadership: pressure-test strategy, surface risks and blind spots early, and bring an opinionated point of view, not just facilitation.
  • Use AI as a default, not an add-on: build reusable, AI-powered workflows for planning, synthesis, and reporting so manual coordination is the exception, not the norm.
  • Spot when a team is optimizing for the wrong thing: recognize when more effort against the current approach won't get us where we need to go, and push teams toward a fundamentally different path rather than a marginal improvement.
  • Raise the bar for how I&O operates, not just how Growth operates: share what's working, question what isn't, and help the broader I&O team build a stronger, more consistent craft.

Here’s what we're looking for:

  • 15+ years in operations, business operations, or strategy & ops at a high-growth tec

jobs.description:
Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn’t work together.

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.

Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

The Role

As we grow Square's presence across the US Retail Channel, we're looking for a Retail Partner Manager to drive awareness and acquisition of Square at major US retailers such as Best Buy, Walmart, Target, and other large format retailers. You'll own quarterly sales and revenue goals for Square Hardware in the channel – optimizing our existing retail partnerships and unlocking new growth within them, from partner mix, placement, and promotional strategy to entirely new ways of partnering. This is a high-ownership role that requires an entrepreneurial operator: someone who navigates ambiguity and setbacks with resourcefulness, engages the right internal partners – across Supply & Demand, Growth Partnerships, Product Marketing, and Finance.

You will:

  • Own channel results: Meet quarterly sales and revenue goals for Square Hardware across US retail, tracking sell-through, forecasting, and growth initiatives tied to seller acquisition and revenue.
  • Build the playbook: Create, test, and evolve go-to-market strategies for key retailers – including approaches that don't exist yet today – moving fast from hypothesis to pilot to scaled rollout.
  • Grow existing partnerships: Own relationships with current retailers and distributor partners end-to-end as their primary contact at Square, proactively architecting new partnership models and formats rather than defending the status quo.
  • Source and sign new partners: Identify, evaluate, pitch, negotiate, and close new retail partnerships from the ground up – often with no existing relationship, internal champion, or playbook to follow.
  • Drive cross-functional execution: Lead work across Supply & Demand, Growth Partnerships, Finance, Product Marketing, and Operations on launches, weekly forecasting, and GTM readiness – proactively pulling in the right people for thought partnership when you hit a wall, rather than waiting to be told.
  • Deploy budget like an owner: Manage the retail marketing budget with a test-and-learn mindset – run scrappy experiments, read results quickly, and reallocate investment with urgency toward what's working.

You Have:

  • 5+ years in business-to-business sales, account management, or retail marketing – preferably in Consumer Electronics, with deep experience at Best Buy, Walmart, Costco, or other large-format retailers.
  • A proven track record of building a partnership, program, or channel from scratch and scaling it to success – without relying on existing playbooks or infrastructure.
  • Resourcefulness and tenacity to push through obstacles and find creative paths to results in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate with high autonomy and minimal oversight: setting your own priorities, moving with urgency, and proactively looping in the right internal partners rather than waiting for direction.
  • The ability to balance quarterly execution with a multi-quarter strategic view – and to see around the corner as the retail landscape evolves.
  • Strong analytical, structured thinking to assess business opportunities and campaign performance, balanced with comfort acting before all the data or process exists.
  • Experience managing external decision makers and influencing cross-functional teams through credibility rather than authority.
  • A BA or equivalent experience; ability to travel (~20%).

jobs.title: Platform Marketing Lead
jobs.description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

About the Team

The Revenue team drives Affirm's top-line growth through strategic partnerships, growth initiatives, and go-to-market execution. We acquire, retain, and expand merchant relationships across eCommerce, in-store, telesales, and the Affirm app. The team leads onboarding, relationship management, and performance optimization to help partners succeed. We deliver value-added solutions, drive adoption, and support long-term business growth by connecting merchants and consumers through Affirm's products.

Within the Revenue organization, Platform Growth Marketing acquires merchants through platforms and partners. We work with PSPs and ISVs to build joint go-to-market programs, activate partner ecosystems, and drive measurable pipeline, GMV, and revenue. As our partner portfolio grows, we’re building reusable programs, assets, and measurement that help multiple partners go to market at once. The team works closely with Partnerships, Sales, Product Marketing, Brand, Legal, and Revenue Intelligence.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Platform Marketing Lead to develop and execute merchant acquisition and activation programs through Affirm’s platform and ISV channels.

You’ll identify the right marketing channels for each opportunity, build integrated campaigns, and use performance data to improve results. You’ll work directly with platform partners and cross-functional Affirm teams to turn merchant insights and business goals into programs that drive acquisition, launch, activation, pipeline, GMV, and revenue.

This is a hands-on role. You’ll move between channel strategy, campaign development, partner collaboration, asset creation, execution, and measurement. Experience with platform or partner GTM is helpful, but we’re primarily looking for a strong marketer who can learn a new ecosystem quickly.

What Success Looks Like
  • Launch integrated merchant acquisition and activation programs through priority platforms and ISVs.
  • Select the right channel mix based on the audience, objective, funnel stage, and available evidence.
  • Connect campaign activity to merchant acquisition, launch, activation, pipeline, GMV, or revenue.

  • Build messaging, campaign briefs, content, partner assets, and measurement plans.

What You'll Do

  • Build campaign briefs, content, partner toolkits, presentations, and performance recaps.
  • Work with Partnerships, Sales, Product Marketing, Brand, Legal, and Revenue Intelligence to move programs from idea to launch.
  • Define campaign objectives, funnel stages, KPIs, attribution assumptions, and reporting requirements.
  • Analyze performance and recommend where to invest, optimize, test, or stop.
  • Learn the business models, audiences, and operating styles of different platform partners.
  • Manage multiple programs while making clear priority and capacity tradeoffs.

What We Look For

  • 6+ years of experience in integrated, channel, growth, lifecycle, demand generation, or product marketing.
  • Experience selecting and managing multiple marketing channels against a defined business objective.
  • A track record of measuring acquisition, conversion, activation, pipeline, revenue, or comparable commercial outcomes.
  • Strong analytical judgment, including the ability to make decisions when attribution or performance data is incomplete.
  • Hands-on experience building campaign briefs, messaging, content, presentations, or performance reports.
  • Strong project management across multiple concurrent workstreams.
  • Ability to learn new products, audiences, and business models quickly.
  • Clear recommendations, personal ownership, and willingness to handle execution details.
  • Strong cross-functional communication and stakeholder management.
Pay Grade - I

jobs.title: Partner Development Manager, AI Partnerships
jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Worldwide Alliances and Channels team develops and manages partnerships that help businesses adopt Stripe’s payments and financial infrastructure. These partnerships create new routes to customers, extend the reach of Stripe’s Sales teams, and help Stripe and its partners serve shared customers.

The role sits on the Americas Alliances and Channels Tech Partnerships team. The team builds and executes joint go-to-market initiatives with major technology companies, with the goal of accelerating Stripe’s commercial growth.

As part of this team, you’ll lead global partnerships across the artificial intelligence ecosystem, with an initial emphasis on leading AI labs. You’ll work across Sales, Marketing, Product, Solutions Architecture, and regional partnerships teams to develop shared opportunities and turn them into scalable global partner strategies.

What you’ll do

As a Partner Development Manager, you’ll define and build Stripe’s global partnerships across the artificial intelligence ecosystem, initially focusing on leading AI labs. Although the role sits on the Americas Alliances and Channels Tech Partnerships team, its mandate is global. You’ll establish relationships across partner organizations, develop shared value propositions, and translate early opportunities into joint commercial and product initiatives.

This is an opportunity to build a new partnership motion from the ground up. You’ll start with focused opportunities, determine what works, and create a playbook that Stripe’s regional teams can apply around the world. Your work will span co-selling, co-marketing, and co-building.

Responsibilities

  • Build senior relationships across the commercial, partnerships, product, and technical organizations of Stripe’s priority AI partners
  • Develop and execute global partner strategies, including shared value propositions, joint business plans, success measures, and operating cadences
  • Identify and launch co-selling, co-marketing, and co-building initiatives that create value for Stripe, its partners, and shared customers
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams across Sales, Marketing, Product, Solutions Architecture, Legal, Finance, and regional partnerships
  • Work with Product and technical teams to identify opportunities for product collaboration and support productive technical conversations with partners
  • Create repeatable partnership playbooks that regional teams can adapt for local markets and AI ecosystems
  • Assess partnership performance, identify opportunities and risks, and communicate progress clearly to senior stakeholders

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 8 or more years of experience in strategic partnerships, partner development, business development, or a related commercial role within technology or another complex business-to-business environment
  • Experience building a strategic technology partnership from its early stages and translating the relationship into joint commercial, go-to-market, or product outcomes
  • Experience developing and executing joint go-to-market plans with external partners and cross-functional Sales, Marketing, Product, or technical teams
  • Experience building relationships with senior external stakeholders and leading global or distributed teams through influence
  • Bachelor’s degree and willingness to travel

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience managing partnerships with artificial intelligence companies, cloud providers, data platforms, developer platforms, or other global technology ecosystems
  • Understanding of the artificial intelligence and data value chain, including the commercial and technical considerations involved in building partner ecosystems
  • Experience across co-selling, co-marketing, and product or technical collaboration
  • Experience developing a partnership framework or playbook that was adopted across multiple regions or team

jobs.description:
Who we are

 

About Bridge

We're creating an entirely new payments platform, built with stablecoins, to simplify global money movement. Bridge enables faster, cheaper payments and borderless access to dollars via stablecoins. Through our APIs, businesses can send and receive funds across borders faster and cheaper vs. SWIFT and other fiat-only rails. Our virtual accounts enable international consumers and businesses to easily access, store, and spend US dollars. Our payouts infrastructure enables platforms to disburse USD to anyone globally. We believe many trillions of dollars will move and settle through stablecoin payment rails. Bridge is pulling this future forward.

We have a small team of people who have previously built financial infrastructure at some of the world's leading companies (Coinbase, Stripe, Square, Brex, Upstart, DoorDash, Airbnb), and each and every one of them chose Bridge because they fundamentally believe that stablecoins will be a critical piece of financial infrastructure that allows for the improvement of global money movement.

About the Role

We’re hiring a Security Analyst / Program Manager to build and scale Bridge’s security foundation. This is a rare opportunity to design the security governance, risk and compliance programs from the ground up, while also leveraging the infrastructure, best practices, and tooling of one of the most mature security organizations in the industry.

Responsibilities

  • Identify and tackle Bridge’s most important security risks quickly and pragmatically.
  • Adopt Stripe’s programs, controls and processes where it makes sense, and find custom approaches where it doesn’t.
  • Reinforce engineering best practices around secure development and infrastructure.
  • Ensure Bridge meets compliance and audit expectations as we scale to more regulated markets.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, product, and Stripe’s security org to move fast without compromising safety.

Minimum Requirements

  • Have 8+ years of experience in Security GRC, ideally with time spent in fast-paced startup environments where you’ve built security practices from the ground up.
  • Have a startup mindset: you’re scrappy, pragmatic, and move quickly to solve the most critical problems.
  • You’re proficient with NIST CSF, OCC’s Cybersecurity Supervision Work Program and/or FFIEC IT Examination Handbook or other similar global frameworks. 
  • Proven prior experience with regulatory audits from Global auditors across Security domains.
  • Thrive in ambiguity and know how to ruthlessly prioritize.
  • Can balance security rigor with speed, especially in fast-moving environments.
  • Demonstrated history converting complex policy, audit, and regulatory mandates into actionable operational and engineering controls.
  • Broad technical depth across cloud architecture, identity management, appsec, data protection, and incident response operations.
  • A track record of evaluating control environments, uncovering underlying risks, and executing sensible, long-term solutions.
  • Strong program execution skills: crafting strategic roadmaps, setting milestones, navigating cross-team blockers, and driving remediation projects to completion.
  • A collaborative approach to partnering across engineering, product, compliance, legal, and audit teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Have experience building or scaling security programs through execution, either at a startup or in an embedded role.
  • Are excited about the potential of crypto and stablecoins to power global financial infrastructure (you don’t need deep prior knowledge—just curiosity and openness to learn).

You'll serve as a trusted partner to Enterprise Sales leaders, adapting global programs to the realities of the EMEA Enterprise motion — longer sales cycles, multi-stakeholder buying committees, and a diverse regional footprint — while staying tightly aligned with our global Field Enablement organization.

  • Deliver live and virtual enablement sessions and implement training programs focused on ongoing ramp and everboarding that improve the performance and productivity of Enterprise sellers and leaders across EMEA.

  • Lead reinforcement and coaching to drive post-program adoption, including designing activities (role plays, deal clinics, skill practice sessions) that connect training to measurable behavior change in real, complex customer scenarios.
  • Partner with Curriculum, Program Management, and Operations to share field insights and pilot or co-build content, and work closely with first-line Enterprise Sales leaders to build trusted relationships, diagnose challenges, and deliver ad hoc training in response to emerging needs.
  • Use AI tools to accelerate delivery and reinforcement — including synthesizing field feedback and surfacing patterns — and model effective AI use for the teams you train.

Who You Are

As the Senior Manager, Head of KYC within Central Compliance, you'll own the global strategy, policy, and program execution for KYC across all Coinbase regulated entities. The KYC function operates as a shared services model, providing compliance advisory to Coinbase's global business lines. You'll serve as Coinbase's subject matter expert and senior escalation point for KYC, driving program design across jurisdictions, managing a team of KYC professionals, and partnering with operations, business, product, and regulatory stakeholders to ensure Coinbase's KYC program scales with the business while meeting evolving global regulatory requirements.  

What you’ll do: 

  • Own the end-to-end strategic direction of Coinbase's Global KYC program, including policy development, program implementation, advisory support, and enterprise-wide process design across all regulated entities.
  • Lead a team of KYC professionals across second-line compliance supporting program design, setting performance standards, developing talent, and ensuring consistent execution across jurisdictions.
  • Drive KYC issue management and resolution globally, providing oversight of corrective actions, systemic enhancements, and first-line KYC function performance.
  • Partner with sales, coverage, account management, customer experience, product, and engineering teams to design and implement KYC initiatives for new product and jurisdiction launches.
  • Serve as the Directly Responsible Individual (DRI) for regulatory reporting and correspondence related to global KYC program inquiries, and deliver senior management and executive-level reporting on KPIs and program health.
  • Shape the interpretation and implementation of global KYC requirements in collaboration with Legal and Compliance colleagues and business stakeholders, designing scalable solutions that balance regulatory compliance with business velocity. 

Required Skills and Experience:

  • 10+ years of experience managing, designing, and implementing KYC programs at a financial institution, including direct people management experience, preferably with digital assets and/or fintech exposure.
  • Deep knowledge of global AML, CTF, and sanctions regulations (e.g., BSA, USA PATRIOT Act, FinCEN CDD Rule, 4MLD/5MLD/6MLD, OFAC sanctions) and demonstrated ability to translate regulatory requirements into scalable KYC program design across multiple jurisdictions.
  • Proven track record of building and scaling a global KYC program from design through execution, including policy development, risk-based frameworks, and operational process implementation.
  • Experience serving as a senior escalation point for KYC/onboarding matters, with the ability to advise on client risk, provide regulatory guidance to cross-functional teams, and represent the KYC function to regulators and senior leadership.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage concurrent regulatory initiatives, jurisdiction launches, and program enhancements in a matrixed environment while delivering executive-level reporting on program performance.
  • Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

Pay Transparency Notice: Base salary varies by location (see range below). Total compensation may also include equity and bonus eligibility, and benefits (medical, dental, vision, 401(k)).

$252,620—$297,200 USD

jobs.description:
Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn’t work together.

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.

Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

About the Role

Square is looking for a senior operations leader to define and manage the global external workforce and partner strategy for seller onboarding. Reporting to the Head of Global Onboarding Operations, this leader will own the operating model for third-party service providers, vendors, and BPO partners, ensuring that external delivery capacity improves seller outcomes while scaling efficiently and responsibly.

This role sits at the intersection of operations, workforce strategy, vendor governance, finance, procurement, legal, and regional execution. The right candidate can evaluate complex build-vs-buy tradeoffs, establish global partner standards, influence senior stakeholders, and create governance mechanisms that improve quality, cost, consistency, and scalability across markets.

What You Will Own

External Workforce Strategy

  • Develop and maintain the global strategy for vendors, third-party service providers, and BPO partners supporting seller onboarding.
  • Partner with regional operations leaders to determine the right labor mix by market, seller segment, service tier, and business need.
  • Lead build-vs-buy analyses and recommend when work should be handled by first-party teams, vendors, BPO, partners, or self-serve models.
  • Create scalable frameworks for external workforce footprint, capacity, quality, cost, and market coverage.

Partner Governance and Performance

  • Establish global SLA frameworks, scorecards, quality standards, business review cadences, and escalation mechanisms for external partners.
  • Hold vendors and BPO partners accountable for operational performance, seller experience, compliance with standards, and continuous improvement.
  • Partner with Procurement, Legal, Finance, and regional teams on contracts, renewals, pricing structures, and commercial terms.

BPO and Vendor Operating Model

  • Oversee the operating model for BPO and vendor-supported onboarding work, including role clarity, performance expectations, enablement, quality assurance, and escalation paths.
  • Ensure partner operations are integrated with Square’s broader onboarding workflows, data, tooling, and seller experience standards.
  • Identify opportunities to improve partner productivity, reduce cost-to-serve, and increase consistency across geographies.

  • As an Associate you'll own a slice of Dasher Tasks end to end; sizing the opportunity, designing the operation, launching pilots, and scaling what works. Your focus will flex to wherever the business needs it most: new task types, commercial pilots or international market expansion opportunities, 
  • First 30 days: learn the business, our metrics, and tooling, and shadow live operations. By 60 days: own a workstream or pilot and ship your first improvements. By 90 days: independently run a pilot or market and move a core metric.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Own end-to-end workstreams across Dasher Tasks, from the first hypothesis and analysis all the way through launching and scaling the operation.

  • Partner broadly with Product, Engineering, Analytics, and S&O leadership. 
  • Build the playbooks, SOPs, and processes that turn a scrappy pilot into a durable business, and see your work in Dashers' and customers' hands within weeks, not quarters.

Applications for this position are accepted on an ongoing basis

jobs.description:
About the Team

Our US Marketplace Strategy & Operations team is responsible for building, scaling and improving the way in which we provide Restaurant delivery. We build our restaurant selection, test 0 → 1 products to give merchants more opportunity to delight their consumers, and optimize ways to improve our marketplace to increase the return on investment our partners gain from partnering with DoorDash. This team focuses on all things Restaurants ranging from selection, to merchandising, to consumer strategy, to leveraging our logistics network in new ways, to so much more! 

About the Role

We are seeking an Associate Manager to join our Marketplace Strategy & Operations team, with a focus on Restaurant Growth. This team is dedicated to growing our restaurant marketplace by launching new selection, enhancing in-app merchandising, helping negotiate new merchant partnerships, and commercializing products that help our restaurant partners grow their businesses on DoorDash. In this role, you will define and execute DoorDash’s restaurant strategy, creating sustainable value for restaurants, consumers, and Dashers while unlocking incremental marketplace revenue.

The ideal candidate will possess a growth mindset, strong analytical skills, and a deep sense of ownership. If you're excited about launching 0 to 1 projects, solving customer challenges, working in fast-paced environments, and managing a marketplace business line with broad impact, this role is for you.

About the Team 

New Verticals launched in 2020 to take the DoorDash marketplace beyond restaurants: it now spans 100,000+ grocery, convenience, alcohol, retail, and DashMart stores and has made DoorDash the #1 third-party marketplace for grocery and retail in the US.

Within New Verticals, the Consumer Strategy & Operations team focuses on building consumer growth levers through many different outlets. The Pricing & Affordability team is redefining what value means in delivery. Our mission is to make DoorDash the smartest, most affordable place to shop. The pricing, fee, and savings systems we build are a big part of why customers choose DoorDash and stay. We're building toward a future where every customer feels DoorDash is worth it on every order. Getting there takes sharp, quantitative thinking about how we price and where we invest.

About the Role

As an Associate Manager, you'll be the core owner behind how we approach consumer strategy using pricing as a growth lever, with a deep focus on fee structure and affordability. You will spend your days understanding our end to end financials by looking at the ins and outs of our P&L, order data and pricing data to drive changes to how we make DoorDash more affordable for our consumers. You’ll work closely with Finance, Analytics, and Product in forecasting consumer and financial impacts, building pricing models, design A/B tests, and launching new fee structures. It's a high-visibility seat at the intersection of strategy, operations, and finance - your analyses will inform decisions that reach millions of customers. 

The best operators today are rapidly generating new ideas, taking ownership over metrics and moving them in the right direction through building product visions, synthesizing complex analyses and testing every idea — all while leveraging AI to uplevel how we operate. We expect this person to stay at the forefront of how AI is reshaping the work, actively exploring new tools, automating repetitive workflows, and finding ways to do in hours what used to take weeks. This is an individual contributor role reporting into a Senior Manager on the New Verticals Affordability team within the broader New Verticals Consumer organization.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Analyze. Run SQL queries and build Excel models to quantify the consumer, operational, and financial tradeoffs of fee changes, leveraging AI tools like Claude & Cursor to automate and move faster.
  • Build with AI. You'll use AI tools to automate manual processes, build new prototypes and develop product visions. You'll be expected to push the boundaries of what's possible with AI in your day-to-day work, and share what you learn with the team.
  • Forecast. Partner with Finance to project how pricing decisions will play out, and track actuals against those projections once programs are live.
  • Experiment. Work with Analytics to design A/B tests across markets and verticals, and translate the results into crisp read-outs and recommendations for senior leadership.
  • Operate and Collaborate. Own the metrics and dashboards for your programs, sharing with partners across the New Verticals organization.

We’re excited about you because…

  • You have 4-6+ years of success in highly analytical roles: investment banking, corporate FP&A, management consulting, corporate strategy, or business operations is required.

  • You are analytical. You thrive on analytical tasks, building models and forecasts from scratch.

jobs.title: Senior Financial Analyst
jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara is looking for a Senior Financial Analyst to join our Corporate Finance & Strategy team. In this role, you will own Samsara's three-statement model and lead our monthly forecast consolidation process and executive reporting, perform quantitative and qualitative analysis to inform strategic decisions, and partner with our Finance Systems team to maintain financial planning tools and improve process efficiency and forecast accuracy.  The ideal candidate is highly self-motivated, analytical, with great attention to detail and thrives in a fast-paced environment.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact – helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best. 

In this role, you will:

  • Support the monthly and quarterly corporate forecasting process and annual operating planning cycle; own and communicate the Finance forecast calendar, and collaborate across Finance & Strategy teams to drive forecast accuracy.
  • Publish monthly forecast and reporting packages with key business metrics, P&L and headcount, highlighting risks and opportunities.
  • Own consolidated income statement, cash flow and balance sheet forecasts.
  • Partner with the Finance Systems team to maintain existing financial planning tools and support development of the AI-driven future state of Samsara's financial data and systems landscape.
  • Drive the long-range planning process and model, partnering across Finance & Strategy teams to align the financial model with strategic priorities and key business assumptions.
  • Lead preparation of board of directors materials, executive leadership financial reviews, and CFO financial reporting.
  • Act as a key cross-functional liaison, driving stakeholder alignment and consistent implementation of changes across teams and systems.
  • Support ad hoc reporting and analysis to inform business decision-making.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 3+ years experience in Strategic Finance or FP&A.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.

jobs.title: Senior Strategic Program Lead, GFCO
jobs.description:
Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase, we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” learn more about working at Coinbase.

Team/Role Overview

The GFCO Programs team is the end-to-end DRI for the financial crimes compliance operations experience and automation across Coinbase's global product and entity footprint. We design, govern, and continuously improve compliance operations through AI-first principles, ensuring regulatory soundness, protecting Coinbase, and delivering a better experience for our customers.

We partner deeply with Central Compliance, Compliance Technology, Engineering & Architecture (EAA), GFCO Operations, Analytics, Workforce Management (WFM), Financial Crimes Data Intelligence (FCDI), and Legal to translate regulatory obligations and operational opportunities into scalable, durable programs across all compliance workstreams, products, and jurisdictions — including Suspicious Activity Monitoring (SAM), Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD), Screening, and Complaints.

As a Senior Strategic Program Lead, GFCO (L5), you will serve as a independent program owner within GFCO Programs — owning one or more complex compliance program verticals end-to-end. You will operate with a high degree of autonomy, drive alignment with Director+ stakeholders, and lead programs that span several cross-functional teams, including external parties. Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

As a Channel Partner Manager for Korea, you will be responsible for building, managing, and scaling strategic partnerships with both System Integrators (SIs) and resellers to accelerate the adoption of our solutions in the Korean market. You will work at the intersection of cutting-edge technology and Korea's unique business ecosystem, helping partners integrate our products into their solution portfolios and joint go-to-market strategies.

As a Channel Partner Manager, you will focus on growing the partner Anthropic reseller and services business in Korea and achieving quarterly revenue and partner attach targets through new customers and upsells. You will be skilled at leveraging cutting edge technology and systems to drive efficiency within the organization you support.

Gusto’s is growing and scaling!  As our business scales and becomes more complex, we’re helping our clients in new and different ways to help them find success.  Join our team to be part of our journey to support our clients HR needs.

  • Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle issues ethically and with integrity.
  • A perpetual learner who strives for excellence while remaining laser focused on our mission to help clients thrive

Our cash compensation amount for this role is between $98,000 - $115,000/year in Denver and most other major cities, and between $119,000 - $140,000/year for New York & San Francisco. jobs.description:
Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn’t work together.

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.

Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

The Role

Block is looking for an entrepreneurial sales leader to build and lead our Strategic Product Sales organization—a specialized team responsible for accelerating adoption of our highest-priority products across new and existing customers.

This is a builder role. You'll partner cross-functionally to identify where we're underpenetrated, develop the commercial strategy to unlock growth, and create scalable cross-sell motions that drive product adoption at scale. You'll lead a team of product sales specialists while partnering closely with Account Executives, Account Managers, Product, Marketing, Revenue Operations, and Enablement to improve how strategic products are sold across the business.

Success in this role requires equal parts commercial strategy, sales leadership, and cross-functional influence.

What You'll Do
Build and Scale a Product Sales Organization
  • Build, hire, and lead a high-performing team of Product Sales Managers and Specialists.
  • Partner cross-functionally to design the operating model, engagement strategy, territory approach, and capacity plan for the organization.
  • Establish forecasting, pipeline management, inspection rhythms, and performance metrics.
  • Partner with Revenue Operations to define goals, compensation, and success measures aligned to commercial outcomes.
Build New Commercial Motions
  • Deploy targeted strategies towards underpenetrated strategic products and design scalable sales motions to accelerate adoption.
  • Develop commercialization strategies that increase attach rates, cross-sell, and expansion revenue.
  • Determine which customers to prioritize, how to engage them, and which sales resources should be deployed.
  • Continuously evaluate performance and refine go-to-market strategies based on customer and market insights.
Lead Strategic Selling
  • Partner with Account Executives and Account Managers on high-value customer opportunities requiring specialized product expertise.
  • Lead complex commercial conversations with executive stakeholders, helping shape account strategy and maximize customer value.
  • Deploy your team of specialists to accelerate strategic opportunities while enabling relationship owners to remain at the center of the customer experience.
  • Remove barriers to winning complex, multi-product deals.

jobs.description:
About the Team

Design Program Managers make DoorDash's Design Studio run better. As owner of the Logistics pillar within Design Operations, you're accountable for one of our most important operating outcomes: maximizing the bandwidth of the team.

About the Role

You'll find where ICs and managers lose time, fragmented workflows, manual processes, meeting overload, unclear rhythms, and you'll define and build the tools and systems that fix it. That might mean shipping a new internal tool, automating a recurring workflow, redesigning how scheduling or reviews work, or establishing a better operating cadence. You own the full loop: diagnose the problem, design the system, build the tool, measure whether it worked.

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Own the Logistics outcome, maximize the bandwidth of the team. ICs and managers have more usable time. Meeting load decreases. The team can focus on high-value work.
  • Identify the biggest sources of operational drag across the Studio and turn them into a prioritized roadmap of tools and process fixes.
  • Define and build the tools, automations, and workflows that reduce manual coordination, including for scheduling, budgets, vendor management, and event logistics.
  • Redesign how the Studio operates: reviews, planning cadences, rhythms for both ICs and managers, information flows,  whatever determines how fast teams can move.
  • Measure whether your systems work, usable time for ICs and managers, meeting load, adoption, hours of manual work eliminated, and iterate.
  • Turn recurring requests into scalable solutions. The second time a problem shows up, build the thing that stops a third.
  • Own scheduling, budget, vendor, and logistics programs as a builder, not a permanent executor, your job is to make them need less manual effort every quarter.
  • Partner with (and, as scope grows, help develop) other DPMs on the Logistics pod.

We're excited about you because you have…

  • 5+ years in operations, program management, or business operations, building systems and tools that made a complex org run better. Design/product/creative org experience is a plus; EA or Chief of Staff backgrounds are welcome if you've built beyond pure execution.
  • A builder mindset: you've created tools, workflows, or automations that replaced manual work — not just performed manual work well.
  • Product-manager instincts applied to operations: find the real pain point, diagnose root cause, prototype, ship, measure, iterate.
  • The ability to own an outcome independently at L4/L5 scope — you don't need the problem pre-scoped for you.
  • Comfort with AI and no-code tooling (Claude, Cursor, Figma, or similar) to prototype and ship internal tools without needing an engineer.
  • Strong written/verbal communication and the judgment to handle sensitive leadership and operational info with discretion.

What success looks like

Maximize the bandwidth of the team. ICs and managers have more usable time. Meeting load decreases. Team can focus on high-value work. Manual workflows become automated. Recurring problems become systems that scale. Your job is to create capacity — not just manage it.

In addition to base salary, the compensation for this role includes opportunities for equity grants. Talk to your recruiter for more information.

jobs.title: Connectivity Partner Manager
jobs.description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join: 

The Airbnb Hotels team is a fun, fast-growing group leading Airbnb’s expansion into the hotel sector. Operating with an entrepreneurial spirit, this team combines the simplicity, product excellence, and guest-centered ethos that define Airbnb. This team’s mission is to deliver the smoothest, most intuitive hotel booking experience for guests, while helping hotels easily drive incremental bookings so they can focus on delivering the best hospitality. The ultimate aim is to help more people discover high-quality hotels, creating value for guests and our hotel partners.

The Difference You Will Make:

We’re looking for an experienced Connectivity Partner Manager to own the health and growth of our network of connectivity providers, including channel managers, property management systems (PMS), central reservation systems (CRS) and other integration partners. You’ll join the Global Hotels Connectivity team, which owns Airbnb’s global relationships with hotel connectivity providers. Using data, automation, and scaled programs, you’ll keep your portfolio integrated and compliant, improving connection quality and operations in close partnership with internal stakeholders.

The ideal candidate is a technical expert with strong project management experience, analytical acumen, and excellent communication skills.

A Typical Day: 

  • Own end-to-end connection performance across a network of connectivity partners, delivering day-to-day support through scaled programs.
  • Build deep knowledge of technical integrations across PMS, CRS and Channel Managers, to provide targeted partner support.
  • Use data to identify strategic opportunities and drive growth.
  • Own scaled communications to all partners on feature updates, mandatory API changes, and deprecations, with clear timelines and next steps.
  • Educate partners on product updates and share partner feedback with internal stakeholders.
  • Troubleshoot partner technical issues to ensure performance.
  • Develop and maintain technical partner resources that support field teams to self-serve.
  • Represent Airbnb at external meetings and industry events, engaging with connectivity and hotel partners.
  • Work with your team to design and manage projects that support the commercial goals of Airbnb and our hotel and connectivity partners.

Your Expertise:

  • 6+ years of experience in a Connectivity Partner Manager or Technical Partner Manager role within a global technology or hospitality tech company.
  • Strong understanding of hospitality/travel software; PMS, CRS, Channel Managers.
  • Proficiency in SQL, Looker and Excel. 
  • Tableau, Asana, Jira  and Salesforce experience preferred.
  • Solid technical troubleshooting skills and project management experience.
  • Excellent communication and presentation abilities, with confidence in engaging clients across multiple channels with stakeholders at various levels. 
  • Effective time management and ability to prioritize in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong quantitative skills with a proven ability to leverage data in decision-making.
  • Adaptability to shifting priorities, projects, and deadlines.
  • Passion for Airbnb, travel, and the sharing economy—being an Airbnb host is a plus

Your Location:

Due to the nature of this position, the successful applicant will need to be based in EST time zone to be able to conduct their work. If your position is employed by another Airbnb entity, your recruiter will inform you what states you are eligible to work from.

jobs.title: Head of GTM Strategy & Operations, Enterprise
jobs.description:
Head of Enterprise GTM Strategy & Operations

Reports to VP, Enterprise Sales  · SF or NY

Reporting to the VP of Enterprise Sales, this role owns both halves of Scale AI’s enterprise revenue engine: the strategy that determines where we play and how we win, and the operating system - people, process, and systems - that makes that strategy executable, measurable, and repeatable.

On the strategy side, you set the analytical foundation for enterprise growth: segment and account prioritization, coverage and territory design, pricing and packaging inputs, and the diagnostic work that explains why the funnel behaves the way it does. On the operations side, you own the RevOps stack, forecasting, compensation design, sales enablement, and the operating cadences that convert strategy into predictable quarterly execution. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable building a segmentation model from a blank page and running a Monday morning pipeline review.

You will lead an established team, with the Head of Sales Enablement and the RevOps Manager as direct reports. Your first job is to raise the ceiling on what that team delivers: sharper analysis, tighter operating rhythm, and enablement that measurably shortens ramp and lifts win rates.

This is a senior, highly visible role partnering with Enterprise Sales leadership, Finance, Marketing, Product, and Solutions Engineering, with regular exposure to the executive team and board materials.

STRATEGY

  • Define which segments, industries, and accounts Scale prioritizes, and build the analytical case behind those choices
  • Build and maintain the market sizing, segmentation, and account-tiering models that drive coverage decisions and investment trade-offs
  • Lead hypothesis-driven analyses of the enterprise funnel - win/loss patterns, conversion drivers, deal economics, coverage gaps - and translate findings into specific changes to how we sell
  • Partner with Finance and Product on pricing, packaging, and deal-structure strategy for enterprise agreements
  • Own the route-to-market point of view: direct vs. partner, land-and-expand mechanics, and where new capacity or capability is needed
  • Build the strategic narrative and executive materials behind annual planning, board reporting, and major GTM investment decisions
  • Serve as a strategic thought partner to Enterprise Sales leaders, bringing an independent, well-argued view on how accounts should be covered and engaged

OPERATIONS & ENABLEMENT

  • Own and evolve the enterprise GTM operating model: account engagement strategy, funnel design, and sales execution standards
  • Direct the RevOps systems stack (CRM, forecasting, reporting, planning tools) through the RevOps Manager, and hold the bar on data integrity and operational discipline
  • Define and operationalize core GTM metrics across pipeline health, deal velocity, forecast accuracy, and rep productivity, with executive dashboards to match
  • Run the sales operating cadence: pipeline reviews, forecast calls, QBRs, and performance reviews
  • Set the enablement agenda with the Head of Sales Enablement - onboarding and ramp, ongoing skill development, and the playbooks and certification that turn GTM strategy into consistent field execution
  • Tie enablement investment to outcomes, measuring impact on ramp time, win rate, and deal quality rather than activity or completion
  • Partner with Sales Leadership and Finance on enterprise compensation plan design, quota governance, and attainment reporting
  • Lead annual and quarterly planning, including territory design, capacity modeling, headcount planning, and quota setting
  • Act as the connective tissue across Sales, Marketing, Finance, Product, and Solutions Engineering for enterprise GTM planning and execution

LEADERSHIP

  • Lead, develop, and retain an established team spanning sales enablement and revenue operations
  • Set clear priorities and standards for a team whose work is consumed by the entire enterprise sales organization
  • Grow the function as the enterprise business scales, making the call on where added capacity creates the most leverage

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 8–12+ years spanning GTM strategy and revenue operations - for example, a foundation in strategy consulting, corporate strategy, or investing paired with in-house GTM Strategy, RevOps, or Sales Ops ownership at a high-growth company
  • Experience managing and developing a team, including managing other managers or senior functional leads
  • Proven ability to frame an ambiguous question, build the analytical approach, and drive to a defensible recommendation on incom

jobs.title: Procurement Solutions Architect
jobs.description: ABOUT RAMP Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books. The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving. We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome. The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same. If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it. ABOUT THE ROLE Ramp is looking for an experienced Solutions Architect, Procurement (Pre-Sales, Enterprise) to serve as the technical and functional expert for Procurement and Procure-to-Pay (P2P) within our Solutions organization. This role is designed for someone who brings deep procurement domain expertise, technical implementation knowledge, and architect-level solution design skills to accelerate Ramp’s most complex, high-value enterprise evaluations. You will support enterprise Account Executives and Solutions Consultants in running sophisticated procurement cycles end-to-end — leading deep discovery, validating technical requirements, designing future-state workflows, and creating pre-sale implementation plans that ensure a seamless handoff to onboarding. You will act as Ramp’s primary procurement SME in the sales cycle and will partner cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, and Post-Sales Solutions to influence roadmap and shape how Ramp’s procurement offering evolves. WHAT YOU'LL DO LEAD TECHNICAL DISCOVERY AND SOLUTION DESIGN - Conduct deep-dive discovery sessions on procurement workflows, vendor management, sourcing, approvals, catalog strategy, and 3-way match requirements - Hands-on experience designing or implementing P2P solutions (Coupa, Ariba, Zip, Ivalua, Workday, NetSuite, etc.) - Strong technical acumen — API experience required, plus familiarity with SFTP, integrations, data migration, SCIM/SAML, and ERP financial objects - jobs.title: Applied AI Architect
jobs.description: About the Team The AI Architect team partners with organizations to turn OpenAI's most capable models into meaningful, real-world impact. We work with customers across industries and digital-native businesses to identify where AI can create value, design secure and scalable solutions, and help those solutions move from early exploration into sustained production adoption. The team brings together technical strategy, customer partnership, and practical deployment expertise, working closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Research, and specialist delivery teams. About the Role As an AI Architect, you will be the senior technical owner for a named portfolio of customers and the primary technical counterpart to their leadership teams. You will act as the “CTO of your book of business”, shaping each customer's AI strategy and guiding their journey from pre-sales discovery and solution evaluation through deployment, adoption, and measurable business impact. You will own the technical account plan across ChatGPT Enterprise, the OpenAI API, Codex, and other agentic AI solutions. In partnership with the Account Director, you will translate business priorities into a focused use-case portfolio, an actionable adoption roadmap, and a clear path to durable customer value and growth. The Account Director owns commercial strategy; you own the technical strategy, customer journey, and path to production value. You will remain accountable for the technical outcome while bringing in the right specialists across deployment, implementation, enablement, security, product, and partners to provide deeper expertise and execute work where needed. This role calls for strong industry fluency, sound architectural judgment, and the ability to move confidently between executive strategy and hands-on technical conversations. In this role, you will: - Serve as the primary technical advisor and long-term technical relationship owner for a named portfolio of existing customers and pre-sales prospects. - Partner with Account Directors on account strategy while owning the technical account plan, technical milestones, adoption priorities, and expansion opportunities. - Lead discovery with executives and technical teams to identify, qualify, and prioritize use cases tied to meaningful business outcomes. - Develop clear Applied AI Architectures spanning models, applications, data, integration, security, privacy, governance, evaluation, and deployment. - Guide customers through technical evaluations, demonstrations, workshops, prototypes, and proofs of value, securing confidence in both the solution and its path to production. - Maintain a focused use-case portfolio with clear decision criteria, ownership, blockers, success measures, delivery needs, and adoption plans. - Develop trusted relationships and technical champions across CTOs, CIOs, CISOs, AI leaders, engineering teams, and other customer stakeholders. - Qualify and coordinate support from Deployment Engineering, implementation, training and enablement, product and domain specialists, partners, and other delivery teams. - Remain accountable for technical progress and customer outcomes while ensuring delivery teams own implementation execution once engaged. - Track adoption, usage, account health, production readiness, and measurable customer impact, intervening early when risks threaten value realization. - Apply industry or digital-native expertise to recognize repeatable patterns, sharpen customer priorities, and identify relevant expansion opportunities. - Share customer insights with Product, Engineering, and Research, translating field learnings into better products, architecture guidance, and reusable practices.
